description: E211 s0. Which sources may make a sample, apart from the index format: the approved sample ids (R7; a fifth id needs an owner ruling), the samples and OSD records refused with the reason, the hosts an input of a named record may be fetched from (R3), and the SPDX identifiers a source licence may carry (Q6: anything else fails closed; a share-alike licence only with store-only placement, R2). samples.py reads it as data; a change is an additive minor of this document with an owner ruling.

refused_samples.teapot-dome: The owner skipped the Teapot Dome sample on 25 Nov 2026 (E211 O2, R7).

refused_records.rmotc/teapot-dome: Teapot Dome is out of the samples (R7); its origin also needs a registration.
refused_records.terranubis/nw-shelf-australia-poseidon-3: Poseidon seismic comes only from the TGS bucket, never from this deposit (R3, E211 O3).
